title: Installer freezes on 'Processing: Closing PowerToys application' and eventually aborts
summary: Installer stalls while closing PowerToys; the original reporter later linked their failure to a damaged command processor AutoRun value.

judgment.rationale: The scenario requires a discriminating comparison before the failing boundary can be established.
evidence: The 0.97.1 installer stalled at Closing PowerToys application; the supplied excerpt shows 0x80070642 after cancellation.

The original reporter reported a corrupted per-user Command Processor AutoRun value and successful installation after clearing it; another participant installed machine-wide using SYSTEM, and a later participant reported the symptom on a 0.97-to-0.99.1 upgrade.

Inspected installer/PowerToysSetupVNext/PowerToys.wxs and terminate_powertoys.cmd: the chain invokes a CMD package that runs taskkill in a bounded loop. The excerpt is a cancellation error, not proof of the initial hang cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported sequence on a current build and isolate the failing boundary.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction or supported behavior investigation may be applicable after resolving the identified uncertainty.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate installer shutdown with CMD AutoRun
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A problematic CMD AutoRun value may interfere with the shutdown package, as reported, but another participant’s matching symptom may have a different cause.
plan: Reproduce in a disposable Windows VM with and without a deliberately problematic test-user CMD AutoRun setting.
Trace bundle shutdown-package invocation and distinguish startup interference from a PowerToys process that fails to close.
If confirmed, make the shutdown path resilient to user CMD startup configuration while preserving graceful termination.
Add focused regression coverage for normal and problematic AutoRun and an unresponsive process.
verification: Installation proceeds in the confirmed AutoRun scenario without modifying user registry settings.
Running PowerToys receives its intended graceful shutdown and unrelated installation paths remain intact.

confidence.rationale: The reported failure boundary and current behavior are not yet established.

reproduce.title: Investigate installer shutdown with CMD AutoRun
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare with the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a suitable Windows test environment and preserve existing user data and settings.
setup: Use a disposable Windows VM and test user with PowerToys installed; preserve the normal command processor configuration.
steps: 1. Run an upgrade with the default test-user CMD startup configuration and record the Closing PowerToys step.
2. In the disposable test profile only, set up a controlled failing or blocking CMD AutoRun command and run the same upgrade.
3. Compare bundle and shutdown-package progress, then test with a running process that does not promptly close.
4. Restore the test profile and confirm the installer did not change the existing user configuration.
reproduce.expected_result: The shutdown step completes or reports a bounded actionable failure without being blocked by unrelated user CMD startup commands.
